title: PH60203: Optical Fiber Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to optical fibers. Applications in communications, medicine, and
sensors. Methods of manufacturing optical fibers and cables. Characterization
of fibers and cables. Optical communication systems, associated accessories.
